metadata.title: Vintage Pub Interior with Diagonal Script

retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key interior photograph of a pub with a central figure in silhouette, featuring prominent diagonal display typography in the upper left quadrant.
triggerTerms: low-key bar lighting with window light

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, dimly lit pub scene where a man sits at a bar counter, illuminated by soft window light from the right, contrasted against a dark, cluttered background of bottles and bar ephemera, topped with bold, slanted typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between dark interior and bright window light
Diagonal text alignment echoing the perspective of the bar
Central figure acting as a silhouette against the background clutter
Warm, earthy tones balanced by cool window light
coreInvariants: Diagonal text orientation at approximately 30 degrees

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man in profile sits in the lower-right quadrant, scaled to occupy about one-third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright window on the right and the large display text in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright text, follows the diagonal down to the subject, and then moves toward the light source on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the upper right and lower left provide areas of rest.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep browns and blacks in the shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale yellow from the window light
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and cream in the typography and curtains
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between light and dark areas.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif and high-contrast script
letterConstructionRules: Display text is slanted upwards to the right
Primary name uses thick outlines and overlapping characters
Secondary text is a slanted, high-contrast serif script
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' in the primary name has an elongated, sweeping descender
Letters are tightly kerned to the point of touching
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, outlined sans-serif paired with a delicate, slanted script for contrast in weight and elegance.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Impact or Headline with custom outlines
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight of the display text
Captures the slanted, informal feel of the subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a 1970s pub interior. A man in a dark jacket sits at a wooden bar counter in profile, looking toward a window on the right. The lighting is low-key, with the background filled with dark shelves of bottles and vintage bar decor. Soft light enters from the window, illuminating the man's face and the counter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of text in the upper left quadrant, both slanted upwards at a 30-degree angle. The top text should be a large, heavy, condensed sans-serif with a thick gold outline. The bottom text should be a medium-sized white script font.

verificationChecks: Is the text slanted at a consistent diagonal?
Is the lighting low-key with high contrast?
Does the display text have a prominent outline?
Is the background cluttered with authentic pub details?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Authentic 1970s film grain and color palette
Legible but heavily stylized diagonal typography

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Ensure the diagonal angle of the text feels intentional and balanced
Verify the color palette remains in the warm, earthy range
Confirm the lighting creates a sense of depth and mood
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-key, candid interior photograph with bold, slanted, outlined display typography to create a nostalgic, cinematic editorial look.
